seo_title: The Exploreans Passport, coming soon | Exploreans
seo_description: Coming soon: the Exploreans Passport, stamped by the guide who leads each experience, and the Travel Journal, written by you. A first look at how they will work.
title: A passport the guide stamps
lead: Imagine a passport that doesn't track where you have been, but how deeply you felt it. Here is a first look.

steps.title: Given at first arrival
steps.body: A passport-format book with your name and number, yours to keep for every future stay. Taking part will be your choice.

steps.title: Stamped on arrival
steps.body: Each place will stamp its place mark, in the colour of its kind, on a fresh page.

steps.title: Stamped after each experience
steps.body: The guide who leads the experience will stamp and sign it, filed under the five families.

steps.title: Mirrored online
steps.body: A digital record will keep your stamps safe, ready for your next stay and for your travel adviser.

spread.headline: One page for every place
spread.body: On the left, the place stamp, the date and the signature of the person who welcomed you. On the right, the five families, with every experience at that place waiting as an empty ring.

rewards.label: Complete a place
rewards.title: Finish a page
rewards.body: Collect every experience stamp at one place to earn an on-site reward, such as a private sundowner or a dinner with the chef.

rewards.label: Collect across places
rewards.title: Fill the Passport over time
rewards.body: Collect place stamps and complete families across the collection for a larger reward, such as a stay voucher.

rewards_note: Taking part will be your choice. Recognition first, rewards second.

journal.headline: A journal you write, in pen
journal.body: The Travel Journal is for reflection: a printed book in which you write, by hand, what you lived and what it meant to you. It will be given at every stay, with a pen, as part of the welcome.
journal.privacy: Your journal will belong to you. It stays private unless you choose to share it.

prompts.prompt: What did you notice at first light that you would have missed alone?
Who did you meet today, and what did they teach you?
What stayed with you today, and why?
When did you last feel this unhurried?
Describe one taste, sound or smell from today as precisely as you can.
What will you carry home from this place, beyond your suitcase?

journal.alt: A guest with a cup of coffee on the terrace of a river tent above the Mara River
